answer_1.quote: We have proposed an unsupervised multi-staged hierarchical approach to generate slides from a long document, referred as DocPres (Document to Presentation).
answer_1.outputs: Presentation slides with titles, bullet‑point text and optional images

answer_2.quote: We have carefully chosen three unsupervised metrics here: 1. Coverage ... 2. Perplexity (PPL) ... 3. LLM-Eval for presentation quality.

answer_3.quote: We use LLM-Eval to measure the overall presentation quality in terms of organization, effectiveness, clarity, coherence, and the ability to convey complex ideas to the audience. We call this metric LLM-Eval and use open‑source LLMs (Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2).

answer_4.quote: We have also conducted a small scale human survey to understand the quality of the generated presentation to human experts... evaluators are instructed to score a generated presentation against each of these metrics in a scale of 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Human reviewers scored each generated presentation on Readability, Consistency, Coverage, Diversity, Flow, and Usability.
